introduction_section.heading: What is
content: At Devisgon, UI/UX design is about understanding your users and creating digital products they actually want to use. User Experience (UX) focuses on the logic, flow, and psychology of the user journey, while User Interface (UI) focuses on the visual aesthetics, branding, and interactive elements.

We don't just make things look pretty. We blend empathy, deep user research, and data-driven insights to build interfaces that solve real problems, reduce friction, and make your software a joy to navigate.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “Good design is obvious. Great design is transparent.”

case_study_section.headline: 50% decrease in user drop-off during onboarding

problem.label: Problem
problem.text: A fintech app had a complex, 10-step onboarding process that overwhelmed users, leading to high abandonment rates.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: We completely redesigned the user flow, chunking information, adding visual progress indicators, and clarifying the microcopy.

result.label: Result
result.text: Onboarding completion rates increased by 50%, and day-one user retention effectively doubled.

faq_section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section.subtitle: Get answers to common design questions

questions.question: What is the difference between UI and UX?
questions.answer: UX (User Experience) is about how the product works—the structure, logic, and user journey. UI (User Interface) is about how it looks—the colors, typography, buttons, and visual styling.

questions.question: Why do I need a prototype before development?
questions.answer: Prototyping allows you to test the product's functionality and flow with real users before writing a single line of code. This prevents expensive development mistakes and ensures the final product meets user needs.

questions.question: Can you redesign an existing app or website?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We start with a comprehensive UX audit of your current platform to identify friction points and drop-offs, then redesign the interface for maximum usability and modern aesthetics.

questions.question: Will I own the final design files?
questions.answer: Yes. Upon project completion, we hand over all source files, graphic assets, and the complete Figma design system, giving you 100% ownership.
